# Bloom vectors: <label> <logs> <bloom>
# logs is comma-separated log RLP, `-` for no logs; bloom is 512
# hex characters. All hex is without 0x.
#
# COMPUTED BY THE EXECUTABLE SPECIFICATION: its own logs_bloom,
# ethereum/execution-specs @ tests@v20.0.1 (87aba1a38, 2026-07-15).
# bloom.py is byte-identical across every fork at that tag.
#
# The Yellow Paper (efc5f9a) defines the same function as
#   M(O) = OR over x in {O_a} + O_t of M_3:2048(x)
# setting bit 2047 - (KEC(x)[i,i+1] mod 2048) for i in {0,2,4},
# bits indexed from 0 at the MOST significant end. The two agree;
# these rows come from the runnable one.
#
# A row carries the logs as RLP rather than as fields, so reading
# it exercises the log decoder too. That coupling is deliberate
# and is stated in the spec that consumes this file.
